# median :: [3, 1, 2]
def median(xs):
    """Median value of a list of numbers (uses a sorted copy)."""
    s = sorted(xs)
    n = len(s)
    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2:
        return s[mid]
    return (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(median([3, 1, 2]))

    s = sorted(xs)
    n = len(s)
    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2:
        return s[mid]
    return (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(median_value([9, 7, 8]))
